مُحْلِبٌ [One who assists in milking. ―
-b2- And hence, in a general sense,] (tropical:) An aider, or assistant: (S, K:) or an aider, or assistant, not belonging to the party, or people, whom he aids: if of that party, or people, the aider is not so called, accord. to the T. (TA. [But see 4.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
